751-1849-4289.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
When Shrieking Drake enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Shrieking Drake by tapping it, adding {U}.
Resolve the Shrieking Drake ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

678-5865-6798.notablePrerequisites: An opponent has lost life this turn
678-5865-6798.description:
Cast Flamecache Gecko by paying its mana cost.
When Flamecache Gecko enters, it triggers, adding {B}{R}.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Flamecache Gecko.
When Flamecache Gecko dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Flamecache Gecko from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability, causing you to surveil 1.
Repeat.

529-1879-7690-8181--165.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, causing you to surveil 1.
Denzilore triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

3259-7060-8139.easyPrerequisites: Scepter of Celebration is attached to a creature you control other than the creature with Breath of Fury attached.
3259-7060-8139.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-7060-8139.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and the creature that has Scepter of Celebration attached, triggering Breath of Fury and Scepter of Celebration.
Resolve the Scepter of Celebration trigger, creating a number of 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a Citizen token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

1981-2415-5789-6797.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-5789-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Lifecreed Duo triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

560-2757-4573.description:
Activate Sacred Mesa by paying {1}{W}, creating two creature tokens due to Queen Allenal of Ruadach.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping a creature token, untapping a basic Plains
Activate the Plains by tapping it, adding {W}.
Repeat steps 2 and 3 one additional time.
Repeat from step 1.

1477-2558-7082.description:
Cast Sword of the Meek by paying {2}.
When Sword of the Meek enters, Sokka and Suki's second ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Extruder by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Resolve the Sokka and Suki trigger, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When the Ally enters, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Ally.
Repeat from step 2.

851-3470-5702-6973.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
851-3470-5702-6973.description:
Play a land.
When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of Mutable Explorer.
When the Mutable Explorer tokens enter, they trigger.
Resolve the first Mutable Explorer trigger, creating two Mutavault land tokens that enters tapped.
When the Mutavault tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko and Lotus Cobra each trigger twice.
Resolve the Lotus Cobra triggers, adding {1}{G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of Mutable Explorer.
Repeat from step 3.

681-5411-6621-6763.easyPrerequisites: Lands you control excluding Mirrorpool can tap to produce at least {2}{C}
681-5411-6621-6763.description:
Cast Splendid Reclamation by paying {3}{G}.
Holding priority, activate any number of lands you control except Mirrorpool by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}.
Activate Need for Speed by sacrificing a land other than Mirrorpool.
Repeat step 3 until Mirrorpool is the only land you control.
Activate Mirrorpool's second ability by paying {2}{C}, tapping and sacrificing it, copying Splendid Reclamation.
Resolve the Splendid Reclamation copy, returning all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
Repeat from step 2.

1829-2438-5220-6900.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing it.
When Carrion Feeder dies, Mortuary and Vindictive Vampire trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Carrion Feeder from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Vindictive Vampire trigger, dealing 1 damage to each opponent and causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Cast Carrion Feeder from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

67-360-1676-5670-6917.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
67-360-1676-5670-6917.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Reveillark.
When Reveillark dies, it triggers, returning Seedship Broodtender and Boss's Chauffeur from your graveyard to the battlefield. Boss's Chauffeur will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it equal to the number of creatures you control.
When Seedship Broodtender enters, it, Soul Warden and Boss's Chauffeur trigger.
Resolve the Soul Warden trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Boss's Chauffeur trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Boss's Chauffeur.
Resolve the Seedship Broodtender trigger, causing you to mill three cards.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Boss's Chauffeur.
When Boss's Chauffeur dies, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Citizen creature token for each +1/+1 counter on it.
When the Citizens enter, Soul Warden triggers that many times, causing you to gain that much life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing a Citizen, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat step 12 two additional times.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{B}{G}.
Activate Seedship Broodtender by paying {3}{B}{G} and sacrificing it, returning Reveillark from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Reveillark enters, Soul Warden triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.
67-360-1676-5670-6917.notes: You must control an additional creature to get infinite +1/+1 counters on Boss's Chauffeur, infinite mana, infinite lifegain, and infinite creature tokens.

uses.n: The Enigma Jewel // Locus of Enlightenment

74-2043-2079-6311.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, targeting Radiant Lotus.
Locus of Enlightenment triggers, copying Urza's ability, targeting Radiant Lotus.
Resolve both Urza abilities, creating two token copies of Radiant Lotus that are 1/1 Soldier artifact creatures.
Activate a Radiant Lotus token by tapping it and sacrificing both Radiant Lotus tokens, targeting yourself.
Locus of Enlightenment triggers, copying the Radiant Lotus token's ability, targeting yourself.
Resolve both Radiant Lotus abilities, adding twelve mana of any color.
Repeat.

95-3944-4768-5646-5660.description:
Cast Blood Pet by paying {B}.
When Blood Pet enters the battlefield, Altar of the Brood triggers.
Holding priority, activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Resolve the Altar of the Brood trigger, causing each opponent to mill two cards due to Bruvac.
If an opponent mills a nonland card, The Wise Mothman triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Blood Pet from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
95-3944-4768-5646-5660.notes: This combo fails if every card milled in step 4 is a land. Having more opponents reduces this chance significantly. Bruvac is also not explicitly required but greatly increases the chances of the combo succeeding. If the combo does fail, you can place a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness and restart the combo again.

4050-4556-6115.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Ozox, adding {1}.
When Ozox dies, it and Blight Mound trigger.
Resolve the Ozox trigger, creating a legendary 2/1 Jumblebones creature token.
Resolve the Blight Mound trigger, creating a 1/1 Pest creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Jumblebones and the Pest, adding {1}{B}.
When Jumblebones and the Pest die, they trigger.
Resolve the Jumblejones trigger, returning Ozox from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Pest trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Cast Ozox by paying {2}{B}.
Repeat.

719-2438-5853.manaNeeded: {3}{B} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
719-2438-5853.notablePrerequisites: Xenograft on the battlefield with "Rat" chosen.
719-2438-5853.description:
Cast Wick either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {3}{B} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Wick enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, if you control a Snail, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the Snail, putting a +1/+1 counter on Carrion Feeder.
If needed, repeat step 3 until you do not control a Snail.
Resolve the Wick trigger, creating a 1/1 Snail creature token.
When the Snail enters the battlefield as a Rat due to Xenograft, Wick triggers.
Repeat from step 3.

3961-4613-4868-5296.notablePrerequisites: Tekuthal has at least one indestructible counter on it, and at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
3961-4613-4868-5296.description:
Activate Tekuthal using Myojin of Towering Might's ability by removing an indestructible counter from it, putting six +1/+1 counters on Workhorse, and two +1/+1 counters on any creature you control.
Activate Workhorse three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Tekuthal by paying {3} and removing three +1/+1 counters from Workhorse, putting an indestructible counter on it.
Repeat.

640-2161-3490-4050.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
640-2161-3490-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Dross Harverster's second ability triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Scion of the Swarm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

1545-3263-4078-4242-4659.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 4.
1545-3263-4078-4242-4659.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Su-Chi, adding {C}{C}.
When Su-Chi dies, it triggers, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Chainer by paying {3} and 3 life, returning Su-Chi to the battlefield from your graveyard.
When Su-Chi enters the battlefield, Trostani triggers, causing you to gain life equal to Su-Chi's toughness.
Repeat.

231-1479-1482.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Plains that enters the battlefield untapped.
231-1479-1482.description:
Activate Jeweled Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding three mana of any color that can only be spent to cast your commander.
Activate Tameshi by paying {W} and returning any Plains that enters the battlefield untapped to your hand from the battlefield, returning Jeweled Lotus  from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Jeweled Lotus enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting a Plains from your hand onto the battlefield.
Activate the Plains by tapping it, adding {W}.
Repeat.

231-1530.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one land.
Your life total is 5 or less.
231-1530.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Second Chance triggers, causing you to sacrifice it and to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Tameshi by paying {3}{W} and returning a land you control to its owner's hand.
Tameshi triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Tameshi ability, returning Second Chance from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Play any land from your hand.
Repeat each turn.

1736-5003-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Ponyback Brigade, adding {R}.
Ponyback Brigade dies, triggering Nim Deathmantle, causing you to pay {4} to return Ponyback Brigade from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Ponyback Brigade enters the battlefield, creating three 1/1 Goblin creature tokens.
Activate Thermopod three times by sacrificing the Goblins, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

461-1561-2607.notablePrerequisites: Archfiend of Despair is level three.
461-1561-2607.description:
Activate Zevlor by paying {2} and tapping it, causing you to copy the next spell you cast this turn that targets a single opponent for each other opponent.
Cast Peer into the Abyss by paying {4}{B}{B}{B}, targeting any opponent.
Zevlor triggers, copying Peer into the Abyss for each opponent.
Resolve each Peer into the Abyss, causing each opponent to draw cards equal to half their library size and lose half their life total, rounded up.
At the beginning of your end step, Archfiend of Despair triggers, causing each opponent to lose life equal to the life they lost this turn.
Each opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.

813-1777-4454.description:
Cast Burnt Offering by paying {B} and sacrificing Scholar of the Ages, adding seven mana in any combination of {B} and/or {R}.
Cast Bond of Revival by paying {4}{B}, returning Scholar of the Ages from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Scholar of the Ages triggers, returning Burnt Offering and Bond of Revival from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

826-2257-4508.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
826-2257-4508.description:
Activate Amoeboid Changeling by tapping it, giving Reckless Fireweaver all creature types until end of turn.
Cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
Reckless Fireweaver triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Malcolm triggers, as Reckless Fireweaver is a Pirate due to Amoeboid Changeling, creating a Treasure token for each opponent dealt damage this way.
When the Treasure(s) enter, Reckless Fireweaver triggers that many times.
Resolve the first Reckless Fireweaver trigger, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Repeat from step 4.

3149-3587.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to give Boros Reckoner lifelink.
You have a way to deal damage to Boros Reckoner.
3149-3587.description:
Give Boros Reckoner lifelink.
Deal damage to Boros Reckoner.
Boros Reckoner triggers, dealing that much damage to itself and causing you to gain that much life.
Repeat step 3 any number of times.
